title: celltypist input schema
description: JSON schema for params.json passed to celltypist.py via BioF3 dispatcher. Compatible with celltypist>=1.6 in biof3-py-runtime.

anndata_file.description: Path to .h5ad file (relative to jobDir or absolute). Must exist and be >1KB.

model.description: Path to a local celltypist model .pkl file (offline-friendly). If provided, takes precedence over model_name.

model_name.description: Built-in celltypist model name (e.g. Immune_All_Low.pkl). Requires network to download if not pre-bundled.

majority_voting.description: Whether to apply majority voting over clusters (over_clustering).

over_clustering.description: obs column key for over_clustering (leiden / louvain / custom).

p_thres.description: Probability threshold for multi-label classification (mode='prob match').

min_prop.description: Minimum proportion of cells in cluster for majority voting.

min_genes.description: sc.pp.filter_cells(min_genes) threshold; cells with fewer genes are dropped.

min_cells.description: sc.pp.filter_genes(min_cells) threshold; genes detected in fewer cells are dropped.
